The intergovernmental fiscal architecture is strengthened.
3 measures of a strategy for improved cooperation between ZRA and local authorities for revenue collection have been implemented.

comment.narrative: 0 measures strategy not available 2022
3 measures of the strategy implemented 2027

A comprehensive study has been carried out to assess the effectiveness of the implementation of the cooperation agreements in a sample of 20 LAs and a set of recommended measures for enhancing mutually beneficial cooperation between ZRA and LAs have been proposed.
